description: A switch passing three inputs to one of eight rows of three outputs, with the row chosen by a trigger on its own row

params.text: Selects that row by hand, and lights while that row is the selected one

inputs.text: A rising edge selects that row, so the three In signals are sent to its outputs
One of the three signals routed to whichever row's outputs are selected

outputs.text: Carries its own column's In signal while that row is the selected one; at other times it gives 0V or holds the voltage it last carried, as the menu is set

menu: Output Mode — Zero sends 0V from the outputs that are not selected, and Last leaves them holding the voltage they last carried
